name: Auroom Cala Glass Aspen - 3 Person Traditional Sauna
description: Auroom Cala Traditional Sauna - Glass Experience the authentic Finnish sauna tradition with the Auroom Cala Glass home sauna. This 3-person model is designed to fit in smaller spaces, while still providing luxurious comfort. The sleek wax finish not only adds a touch of elegance, but also protects the wood for long-lasting use. The Cala is composed of thermally modified Aspen sourced from northern Europe, ensuring long-lasting durability. Through a chemical-free process utilizing heat and steam, this wood surpasses others in longevity and withstands the intense heat of a sauna. Its full-glass front boasts stunning aesthetics and maximizes natural light within. This cozy sauna is easy to assemble and can be installed in practically any space. With its straightforward setup and low energy demands, it is easy to use and cost-efficient to run. The Sauna heater is sold separately.
